accused_statement.statement_text: I, Ravi Shankar Yadav, s/o Ram Shankar Yadav, state that I was working as security guard at Rishi Apartments until September 2024 when I was dismissed by the RWA Secretary Rajiv Chawla on false allegations of theft. I was very angry because I had worked there for two years. After dismissal, I could not find another job and my family was facing financial problems. I knew the routine of all residents of the building. I knew that the Malhotra family on the third floor went to their jewellery shop every morning and returned only in the evening. I also knew from my time as security guard that they kept gold ornaments at home. On 20th November 2024, I took my motorcycle and went to Rishi Apartments at around 2:15 PM. I told the new guard Mahesh that I had come to meet Ranjit in maintenance. I went up to the third floor with an iron rod that I had brought from home. I broke the lock of Flat 302 and entered. I used the iron rod to break open the steel almirah. I took gold ornaments, silver items and cash. I put everything in a black bag and left. I went straight to my house in Rehgar Pura. I sold some of the ornaments to a jeweller in Sadar Bazar and used the cash for my family expenses. I admit I committed this theft because I was angry at being dismissed and needed money. I am sorry for what I did. I will cooperate with the police and return whatever is left with me.
accused_statement.remarks: Statement recorded voluntarily in presence of witness. Accused was given time to consult legal aid counsel provided by DLSA but declined. Statement led to recovery of stolen ornaments worth ₹6,80,000, cash ₹85,000, iron rod used in the crime, and motorcycle DL4SBK7890.
